source.citation: M. Schaefer and S. Turek, Benchmark computations of laminar flow around a cylinder, Flow Simulation with High-Performance Computers II, Notes on Numerical Fluid Mechanics 52, 547-566 (1996); archived FeatFlow DFG benchmark 2D-2 reference results

observable_definitions.strouhal: St = f*D/U_mean, with D=0.1 and U_mean=1.0
observable_definitions.cd_mean: time mean of drag coefficient using the DFG/FeatFlow force normalization for benchmark 2D-2
observable_definitions.cd_amplitude: half peak-to-peak drag-coefficient amplitude under the same DFG/FeatFlow normalization
observable_definitions.cl_amplitude: half peak-to-peak lift-coefficient amplitude under the same DFG/FeatFlow normalization

notes: Reference values use the fine FeatFlow Q2/P1disc periodic benchmark result (level 6, k=1/200 where tabulated). Candidate evidence must declare the identical regime and observable definitions. Tolerances are NS-SIM verification gates, not measurement uncertainty.
